title: dendrolobium umbellatum
intro: Dendrolobium umbellatum, commonly known as the Umbellate Dendrolobium, is a plant species that belongs to the Fabaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, which include being anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal. The therapeutic actions of Dendrolobium umbellatum include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate digestive issues, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
